do: Place in curbside recycling bin. Rinse lightly if needed.
dont: Do not crush if your local program asks for intact cans.
local_note: Most California programs accept aluminum cans.

do: Drop at hardware store or Household Hazardous Waste (HHW) facility.
dont: Do not place in curbside bin or trash.
local_note: Orange County HHW facilities accept household batteries.

do: Flatten and place in recycling bin. Keep dry.
dont: Do not recycle if contaminated with food or grease.
local_note: Irvine accepts flattened cardboard in curbside recycling.

do: Check local guidelines; some cities accept in recycling.
dont: Often not accepted due to plastic lining.
local_note: Many California cities do NOT accept disposable coffee cups.

do: Drop at certified e-waste recyclers or HHW events.
dont: Never put in regular trash or recycling.
local_note: Many retailers offer free e-waste drop-off in California.

do: Compost at home or use organic waste collection if available.
dont: Do not put in curbside recycling.
local_note: Irvine offers organic waste collection for some residents.

do: Rinse and recycle in glass bin if accepted locally.
dont: Do not mix broken glass with curbside recycling.
local_note: Glass is accepted in Orange County recycling programs.

do: CFL: HHW drop-off. LED: some stores accept returns.
dont: Do not put in curbside bin.
local_note: Home Depot and Lowe’s often accept CFLs.

do: Empty, rinse, and recycle. Keep caps on if accepted.
dont: Do not recycle plastic bags or film.
local_note: Most California curbside programs accept PET bottles.

do: Return to grocery store drop-off if available.
dont: Do not place in curbside recycling.
local_note: Many supermarkets in Irvine offer bag recycling bins.

do: Tear off clean top and recycle; trash greasy bottom.
dont: Do not recycle heavily soiled paper.
local_note: Common item for contamination — when in doubt, trash it.

do: Generally trash. Some specialized drop-offs accept clean foam.
dont: Do not put in curbside recycling.
local_note: Rarely accepted in California curbside programs.

do: Rinse and recycle where carton recycling is accepted.
dont: Do not recycle if local program excludes cartons.
local_note: Check OC Waste & Recycling for carton acceptance.

do: Take to tire retailer, auto shop, or HHW event.
dont: Do not leave at curbside or dump illegally.
local_note: California tire retailers often accept old tires for a fee.

do: Keep dry and place in curbside paper recycling.
dont: Do not recycle if wet or soiled.
local_note: Standard curbside paper recyclable in Irvine.
